# Test fixtures

* `portrait_mediapipe_apache2.jpg` - MediaPipe test asset from
  `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/portrait.jpg` (Apache-2.0, google-ai-edge/mediapipe).
  Used to synthesize face-containing test videos in `tests/conftest.py`.

Do not add recordings of real people. Synthetic media is generated at test time with PyAV.
